title: On the Kashaev--Luo--Vartanov Partition Function for Cusped 3-Manifolds: Asymptotics and a squared norm property
summary: We study the asymptotic and TQFT-type properties of the Kashaev--Luo--Vartanov (KLV) partition function. We show that the partition function depends on the prescribed angle structure only through its peripheral angular holonomies. For any geometric triangulation of a cusped 3-manifold realizing a possibly incomplete hyperbolic structure, we express the exponential decay rate and the 1-loop term of the partition function in terms of, respectively, the volume and the adjoint twisted Reidemeister torsion of the corresponding incomplete hyperbolic structure.
